exact_matched_fa.comparison: FP32 score >= FP32 threshold; original threshold-zero behavior retained

reference_comparison.note: Integer counts compared exactly. Reference IoU may have been rounded; both values retained.

geometry_protocol.distance: Chebyshev distance in source pixels to nearest PNG>0 pixel
geometry_protocol.protection: official_metrics._protected_pixels, original +/-4 slices including border anomalies
geometry_protocol.matching: 8-connected GT and prediction components; original +/-1 slices per GT pixel
geometry_protocol.counts: foreground_fp_pixels: distance0; near_fp_pixels: distance1..32; far_fp_pixels: >32; empty_gt separate
geometry_protocol.component_areas: Whole prediction-component areas. Per-GT union sums unique associated components; the same component can associate to multiple GTs.
geometry_protocol.interpretation: Descriptive geometry only; no causal attribution and no exclusion of training-mask influence.

inference_protocol.frame_fusion: maximum over overlapping windows; each source frame output once
inference_protocol.sigmoid: FP32 torch.sigmoid on the model device; no float16 intermediate

variants.native: sigmoid of native frame logits, without score calibration
